definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that is stylish, well-dressed, or has good taste in fashion and appearance.
As a noun or suru-verb, refers to the act of dressing up or paying attention to one's appearance.

examples.japanese: おしゃれな⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧おしゃれ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おしゃれ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{出|で}かけよう→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's dress up and go out today.
examples.notes: おしゃれ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to dress up

examples.japanese: おしゃれな⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きだ→好き：02355_suki⟧。
examples.english: I like walking around fashionable neighborhoods.
My younger sister pays attention to her appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧おしゃれ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Since it's my friend's birthday party, I think I'll dress up more than usual.

notes:
Can function as a na-adjective, noun, or suru-verb.

FORMS:
- おしゃれな + noun (おしゃれな⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ = stylish clothes)
- おしゃれ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to dress up, make oneself stylish)
- おしゃれさん (a fashionable person - affectionate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おしゃれな⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (stylish shop)
- おしゃれな⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧ (fashionable neighborhood)
- おしゃれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to care about one's appearance)

Can be written with kanji as お{洒落|しゃれ}, but hiragana is more common.
